GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , held rails behind Fast Pace Leaders 4 Lengths 600m, dropped out in Straight , Vet revealed no abnormalities # dropped out

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Prior to the declaration of correct weight Stewards identified that the mare’s barrier gates were slow to open which resulted in the mare being slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5l Went Forward Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m took lead 2 Lengths home turn 1st Under Pressure weakened final 200m # led/poor late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide in the early stages. Rounding the home turn was momentarily tightened between the rail and another runner, which shifted in slightly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Settled Down 5th 3 Wide 3 Lengths 600m 6th 3 Wide 4 Lengths Straightened Up 6th Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # wide/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up when being restrained in teh early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drove through to be joint lead rail, under pressure turn and dropped out # Eq lead/gone turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 900m bumped with a runner and became unbalanced.  Rider reported that her mount travelled well throughout the event, however, failed to respond to her riding in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare which was beaten 25L revealed no abnormalities. Trainer advised Stewards that the mare will undergo a veterinary examination including an endoscopic examination. Trainer undertook to report the results to Stewards. Tnr reported vet exam revealed epiglottic entrapment. Surgery to be undertaken. Subsequently, Stewards elected to to take no further action.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair pressed on to face breeze half off, under whip turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, found little and plodded home # breeze/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the tactics adopted, rdr stated that the intention was to ride the horse more prominently today, as it had been at a previous start when it finished first. Whilst tnr confirmed the instructions, he was nevertheless reminded of his obligation to notify Stewards of any change of tactics.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered @ start & lost ground. Niggled early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to chase on inside (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 200m & held ground in straight. # Even effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered at the start and lost ground. Approaching the 400m was awkwardly placed inside the heels of another runner which shifted in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair bustled sat rail 3l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear and kept on one pace # had run/fair
